problem_statement: Write a program to reverse a given string. Given Input: str1 = \"PYnative\". Expected Output: evitanYP.

dimensions.name: Correctness
dimensions.description: This dimension evaluates if the algorithm's logic accurately reverses any given input string, ensuring the final output string is a true reversal of the original.
sub_criteria: The logic correctly determines the order of characters for the reversed string, placing the last character first, the second-to-last character second, and so on.
The algorithm ensures that all characters from the original string are present in the final output string and no extraneous characters are added or omitted.
The algorithm correctly handles strings of varying lengths, including those with an even or odd number of characters.

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.description: This dimension assesses whether all essential components of the string reversal algorithm are present, from input handling to result formation and edge case management.
sub_criteria: The algorithm describes a clear input mechanism for accepting the original string.
The algorithm includes a method to process each character of the input string.
The algorithm describes storing or accumulating the reversed characters into a resulting string or sequence.
The algorithm covers edge cases such as an empty string or a string with a single character.

dimensions.name: Clarity
dimensions.description: This dimension evaluates the logical readability and human-understandability of the pseudocode, ensuring the steps and flow are easy to comprehend.
sub_criteria: The logical flow from input to the final reversed string is easy to follow step-by-step.
Variable names and descriptions of steps clearly convey their purpose within the algorithm.
The method for building the reversed string is unambiguous and straightforward to understand.

dimensions.name: Efficiency
dimensions.description: This dimension evaluates the student's awareness of computational performance by checking if the algorithm avoids obviously unnecessary operations or redundant processing steps.
sub_criteria: The algorithm avoids unnecessary multiple full passes over the input string to achieve the reversal.
The algorithm does not perform redundant character operations, such as re-processing characters that have already been correctly placed in the reversed string.
